statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and transient loss of consciousness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
A cardiac event monitor (CPT 93271) is ordered
The cardiac event monitor is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmic activity and guide further management
The denial reason is that the requested service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
